label_rule: 1 fps, person conf >= 0.6, >= 8 joints with score >= 0.3, one person per frame, head removed before saving (12 joints)
subjects: 1-20 (60 videos); 48 train videos / 12 validation videos (sorted by name, shuffled with seed 42, first 20%)
note: mAP is agreement with the yolo11x teacher on pseudo-labels, not human annotation; OKS sigmas are the COCO body sigmas with shoulder/elbow/wrist divided by 1.5, not the standard COCO table
